verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Pulumi serves a real llms.txt at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a structured Pulumi summary), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Pulumi also maintains an AI section of its docs covering agent integrations. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), any first-party documentation of the llms.txt's scope or an llms-full variant, and independent corroboration that agents get useful results from it.
